answer: A willow bond in the tundra registry: each identity locks 90 credits in three layers of 30, plus 15 fee. Root frees on one verified job, trunk after three clean epochs, canopy only on a zephyr audit, a fresh task only its key holder can answer. Reused receipts burn the stack; rented willows fail, each layer key-bound to its own log. 1,000 fakes lock 105,000 versus a 40,000 pool, a 65,000 loss; an honest identity pays 105 once and frees all three.
